title: Rajadurai
desc: Rajadurai, a police officer, succeeds in capturing Mayandi, a gangster, and sending him to jail. Later, Mayandi kidnaps Rajadurai's son, Vijay, and raises him as a criminal.

title: Anandha Gummi
desc: Jeeva, the son of a rich landlord, falls in love with Selvi, the daughter of a widow. Problems arise when the landlord marries Selvi's mother.

title: Vietnam Colony
desc: A real estate company appoints Krishnamurthy to vacate a colony, claiming it is filled with anti-social elements. He gradually realises that the company is being unjust to its residents.

title: Veetla Eli Veliyila Puli
desc: An otherwise confident Purshottaman finds himself completely dominated by his overbearing wife. Desperate to escape his uncomfortable situation, he turns to his colleague, Sivaraman, for help.

title: Veeram Velancha Mannu
desc: Durai Pandi, a lumberjack, is very fond of his sister Meenamma and aims to make her the district collector. However, the MLA tricks him into cutting sandalwood trees and smuggling illegal goods.
